description: Land Title Settlement Dept. -Pattigoda, Attanagalla D/S Division Gampaha District - Cad. Map No.510625 (24/0652)
categorisation: This gazette content exclusively deals with land title registration matters under the Registration of Title Act. It contains detailed declarations of land title determinations for specific parcels of land, including parcel numbers, owner names, extent of land, title classifications, and encumbrances. The content focuses entirely on land ownership and property rights, falling squarely within the Land Gazette classification (Type 4) without any government personnel changes, organizational restructuring, or other specialized categories.
